purpose: E04-E06 bounded observability, identical-history and strict martingale experiments for a trader decision-support research programme.
scope: A tractable linear Gaussian instrument-price world, separate from the original bond ecosystem. No claim of market calibration, inventory-clearing dynamics or replication of the full CGB learner.
oracle_access: Current hidden pressure and true DGP parameters, never future innovations.
kalman_access: Observed returns and proxy messages after their declared receipt time; true DGP parameters known.
ridge_access: Observed 1/5/15/30-minute mean returns and most recently received proxy; TRAIN-fitted scaling/coefficient, CAL-fitted Gaussian residual scale.
primary_measure: Mean continuous Gaussian negative log likelihood by independent world; paired differences and 95% normal intervals over world means.
secondary_measures: forecast mean sensitivity to unavailable future data
selection_rule: All declared configurations are reported. No best configuration selected from TEST, no hyperparameter search, and no declared production-readiness threshold.

twins.description: Shared received prefix and innovations; at the change boundary latent target switches to continuation or reversal. Same fixed causal observer in both, explicitly misspecified after the change.

martingale.description: Symmetric independent tick innovations; predictable bounded positions, price-touch accounting, fixed finite horizon, no future-informed action. The audit recomputes each gain and crossing cost.
